events.title: 아스널 lift the Charity Shield thanks to a 2–1 victory over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Wembley .
아스널 sell 니콜라 아넬카 to 레알 마드리드 for £23 million – the highest fee involving a British club.
아스널 sign Thierry Henry for an estimated fee of £11 million, reuniting with his former manager 아르센 벵거 .
리즈 유나이티드 sell Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink to 아틀레티코 마드리드 of Spain for £12 million.

위건 애슬레틱 mark their first game at the JJB Stadium with a 3–0 win over 스컨소프 유나이티드 in Division Two . The first Premier League games of the season include 첼시's 4–0 home win over newly-promoted 선덜랜드 and 왓퍼드 's 3–2 home defeat against 윔블던 in their return to the top flight. 브래드퍼드 시티 mark their first top-flight game since 1922 with a 1–0 away win over 미들즈브러 , in which Dean Saunders scores a late winner.
페예노르트 wins the 요한 크라위프 Shield , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , by a 3–2 win over Ajax at the Amsterdam Arena .
케빈 필립스 scores his first two Premier League goals in 선덜랜드's 2–0 home win over his old club 왓퍼드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 4–0 at Old Trafford . Michael Bridges scores a hat-trick for 리즈 유나이티드 in their 3–0 away win over 사우샘프턴. 리즈 유나이티드 sign 코번트리 시티 striker Darren Huckerby for £4.4 million.
Tommy Mooney scores for 왓퍼드 in their shock 1–0 league win at 리버풀.
19-year-old 울버햄프턴 원더러스 striker Robbie Keane becomes 코번트리 시티's record signing in a £6 million deal.
맨체스터 유나이티드 captain Roy Keane scores twice in a 2–1 win over 아스널 at Highbury .
케빈 필립스 and 나이얼 퀸 plunge 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 into crisis as they score in 선덜랜드's 2–1 derby win at St. James' Park,
라치오 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 in AS 모나코 to win the European Super Cup .
뤼트 휠릿 resigns after one year as manager of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
Andy Cole scores four goals against his old club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat them 5–1 at Old Trafford.

The first month of the league season ends with treble winners 맨체스터 유나이티드 looking well placed for retaining their league title as Premier League leaders with five wins and a draw from their first six games. 애스턴 빌라 are their nearest contenders, while 첼시, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 레스터 시티 complete the top five. 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, both winless, prop up the rest of the top flight, while 브래드퍼드 시티 occupy the final bottom three position at the end of the first month of their first top division season for nearly 80 years. 입스위치 타운 are hopeful of making it back to the Premier League after five seasons away (during which time they have suffered three play-off disappointments) as they finish the first month of the season as Division One leaders. 스톡포트 카운티 have emerged as surprise contenders for a Premier League place as they stand second in Division One. The playoff zone is occupied by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , 맨체스터 시티 , 버밍엄 시티 and 풀럼 .
